signal.rationale: The 11.00 crore order is firm (agreement executed) and equals 32.9% of TTM revenue of 33.48 crore. It is routine by history, since comparable orders of 4 to 30 crore have been disclosed since 2023, but TTM operating margin of -24.8% triggers the thin-margin exception; TTM growth is not shown and is listed as missing, so it is decided as not routine. The company is loss-making (TTM PAT -10.37 crore) and equity-funded, which is a deep-research funding question rather than a disqualifier, since no debt level or default is shown.
